name: CareLoop Agentverse Care Companion
tagline: Agents coordinate care for older adults: booking, pharmacy, prescription explanations and caregiver updates from one plain request.

awards: Fetch.ai: OmegaClaw Skill Forge powered by Agentverse

problem: A simple health need turns into several separate workflows for older adults and caregivers.
solution: An orchestrator on ASI:One or Telegram routes to specialist uAgents for provider search and booking, over-the-counter medicine with a service fee, prescription explanation, caregiver notifications and emergency escalation.
demo_moment: Team-described: say you have a cough and need help, then follow the care timeline.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Fetch.ai: OmegaClaw Skill Forge powered by Agentverse” among 307 submissions.
Each specialist agent runs and tests on its own, built by one person.

lessons: Meet older users in a channel they already use and hide the agent map behind it.
